title: rest.sessions.captures.request
description: POST /api/sessions/{id}/captures: the `metadata` JSON part of a multipart/form-data burst whose images travel as sibling parts named in `images[].part`. Idempotent on `capture_id`: a repeated id is answered `duplicate` and stores nothing.

capture_id.description: Client-generated lowercase UUID; the idempotency key.

command_id.description: The command message that asked for this capture, when trigger is command (ADR-0006).

client_time_ms.description: Client clock when the burst started, Unix epoch ms.

part.description: Name of the multipart part carrying this image's bytes.

client_time_ms.description: Client clock when this still was taken, Unix epoch ms.
